title: Functional Cognitive Continuity & Resumption Checkpoints
hypothesis: A structured checkpoint containing hypotheses, evidence, failed approaches, and next discriminating experiments will improve successful research resumption by at least 20 percentage points over an equally sized narrative summary.
falsification_criteria: Resumption improvement is below 20 percentage points on held-out interrupted investigations.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
